criteria.rule: Compare current disconnected record access. Prefer create and edit records with later synchronization over read-only access to cached records; prefer cached reading over requiring a live connection for all access. If either source does not establish its capability, return UNRESOLVED. Equal established capability is TIE.

Compare recovery after an interrupted processing job. Prefer automatic resumption from a durable checkpoint over manual retry retaining completed work; prefer retained work over restarting from the beginning and discarding completed steps. If either source leaves recovery unspecified, return UNRESOLVED. Equal established capability is TIE.

Compare current interoperable file exchange. Prefer both CSV and JSON import and export preserving schema and types over CSV import and export alone; prefer CSV exchange over proprietary-only records with no CSV or JSON import or export. If either source leaves exchange unspecified, return UNRESOLVED. Equal established capability is TIE.
